EPISODE MAP:
- Scene 1 (L0001-L0008): Mona & Mother at home. Setup: Mona wears makeup from promo, Mother warns of father's temper.
- Scene 2 (L0009-L0025): Mona & Soni discuss beauty promo and plan to shoot a reel.
- Scene 3 (L0026-L0054): Mona & Soni shoot a reel outdoors.
- Scene 4 (L0055-L0099): Mona & Soni debate monetization. Soni lectures Mona on capitalizing on fame before it melts like ice cream.
- Scene 5 (L0100-L0140): Sukku & friend discuss Mona gaining 33k followers; Sukku greets Mona and believes she won't change.
- Scene 6 (L0141-L0173): Smitha advises Mona to avoid local guys and target rich influencers; waiting for promoter Deepak.
- Scene 7 (L0174-L0232): Deepak pitches fast money and brand deals to Mona.
- Scene 8 (L0233-L0249): Smitha explains Deepak's cut and cautions Mona.
- Scene 9 (L0250-L0281): Father calls demanding live location; Smitha installs a fake location app to fool him.
- Scene 10 (L0282-L0307): Mona gifts a saree to her mother using reel money, pretending it is scholarship money.
- Scene 11 (L0308-L0371): Intercut: Father drinks with Rao who rants about shameless girls on reels; Mona offers remaining money to Mother.
- Scene 12 (L0372-L0410): Mona & Sukku terrace conversation; romantic reassurance and significance of his like.
- Scene 13 (L0411-L0434): Drunk father issues a chilling ultimatum against social media and reels.
- Scene 14 (L0435-L0450): Soni is frightened; Mona promises to shield her.
- Scene 15 (L0451-L0461): Sponsored camera ad (Sony FX3).
